thig10.1:1.1: samatto. || kalyāṇamittatā muninā lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā | kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno api bālo paṇḍito assa. || ||
thig10.1:2.1: bhajitabbā sappurisā paññā tathā pavaḍḍhati bhajantānaṃ | bhajamāno sappurise sabbehi pi dukkhehi mucceyya. || ||
thig10.1:3.1: dukkhañ ca vijāneyya dukkhassa ca samudayaṃ | nirodhañ ca aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ cattāri ariyasaccāni. || ||
thig10.1:4.1: dukkho itthibhāvo akkhāto purisadammasārathinā | sapattikaṃ pi dukkhaṃ appekaccā sakiṃ vijātāyo || ||
thig10.1:5.1: gale apakantanti sukhumāliniyo visāni khādanti | janamārakamajjhagatā ubho pi byasanāni anubhonti. || ||
thig10.1:6.1: upavijaññā gacchantī addasāhaṃ patiṃ mataṃ panthe | vijāyitvāna appattāhaṃ sakaṃ gehaṃ. || ||
thig10.1:7.1: dve puttā kālaṅkatā pati ca panthe mato kapaṇikāya | mātā pitā ca bhātā ca ḍayhanti ekacitakāyaṃ. || ||
thig10.1:8.1: khīṇakulīne kapaṇe anubhūtaṃ te dukkhaṃ aparimāṇaṃ | assu ca te pavattaṃ bahūni jātisahassāni. || ||
thig10.1:9.1: passiṃ taṃ susānamajjhe atho pi khāditāni puttamaṃsāni | hatakulikā sabbagarahitā matapatikā amatam adhigacchiṃ. || ||
thig10.1:10.1: bhāvito me maggo ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko amatagāmī | nibbānaṃ sacchikataṃ dhammādāsaṃ apekkhi 'haṃ. || ||
thig10.1:11.1: ahaṃ amhi kantasallā ohitabhārā kataṃ me karaṇīyaṃ | Kisāgotamī therī suvimuttacittā imaṃ bhaṇī ti. || ||
